articles.제목: The Nuclear Company proposes 6.6 GW Kentucky project
articles.원문 요약: The Nuclear Company has outlined plans for an energy campus in Lewis County, Kentucky, which could feature up to six AP1000 reactors - this would make its 6.6 GW capacity larger than any current nuclear power plant in the USA.

articles.제목: IAEA says Barakah drone-strike response was effective
articles.원문 요약: An International Atomic Energy Agency mission to the United Arab Emirates has said that effective action was taken following the loss of off-site power to Barakah Nuclear Power Plant's unit 3 following a drone strike in May which caused a fire in a generator located outside the inner perimeter of the plant.

OPG firm joins UK BWRX-300 project
articles.원문 요약: The UK-based project company of European SMR developer and investor SGE, and Origin Nuclear, a subsidiary of Ontario Power Generation, have signed a letter of intent to establish a joint venture for the future operation of a planned fleet of 14 BWRX-300 small modular reactors.

articles.제목: Radiant microreactor selected for deployment by US Navy
articles.원문 요약: The US Navy has selected Radiant's Kaleidos microreactor for deployment at Naval Weapons Station Crane, Indiana.

articles.제목: SMRs could be part of Port of Rotterdam's future, says study
articles.원문 요약: The Dutch port of Rotterdam could become part of the future small modular reactor supply chain - with opportunities extending well beyond the adoption of nuclear technology itself, according to a study conducted jointly by Tractebel and Technopolis Group.
